usage: Blood glucose monitoring for home and professional use
desc: GlucoSpark Glucose Test Strips are disposable electrochemical biosensor strips designed for use with the GlucoSpark Blood Glucose Monitoring System. They require only 0.5 µL of capillary whole blood and provide accurate blood glucose results in approximately 5 seconds. The strips feature no-coding technology, helping reduce user errors and ensuring quick, convenient testing for home and professional use.
